---
title: "UVC Disinfection Aerial Robots"
date: 2021-01-01
categories: [UAV, robotics]
description: "An autonomous UAV prototype for disinfecting indoor spaces during COVID-19."
image: ../images/uav.gif
---

This prototype explored an autonomous UAV for UVC disinfection in large enclosed spaces such as universities, hospitals, and public buildings. The project involved robot hardware, sensing, autonomous navigation, and safety-focused design for operating in shared indoor environments.
